desired_execution_windows_bangkok.name: morning_ATO
desired_execution_windows_bangkok.purpose: Apply previous completed-day signal; lock quantities for the day

desired_execution_windows_bangkok.name: afternoon_ATO
desired_execution_windows_bangkok.purpose: Reconcile confirmed morning fills; retry valid residuals using confirmed cash

desired_execution_windows_bangkok.name: closing_ATC
desired_execution_windows_bangkok.purpose: Final same-day residual/risk check using information available before auction

rules: Three opportunities to act, not three mandatory trades
ATO/ATC require verified exchange pre-auction state and broker order support; never submit a late ATO
Daily final close cannot be used for that same closing auction
All lot sizes, availability, action-adjusted reference prices and buying power must come from current broker/exchange metadata
Sale proceeds cannot finance buys in the same auction; only confirmed later available buying power may be used
Residuals must be reconciled with actual fills/cancellations before retry; intent IDs must prevent duplicate submission
No fixed stop-loss is included in the selected performance. A portfolio halt threshold remains to be agreed and tested
Corporate-action odd lots need a separate exit process; auction-only liquidation may leave residual holdings
